import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("project_rewrite_prompt_template")
selected = data.get("selected_projects")

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Project rewrite prompt is missing.")
if not isinstance(selected, list):
    raise ValueError("selected_projects must be an array.")

inputs = []
for project in selected:
    content = project.get("content")
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        raise ValueError("Each selected project needs a content array.")
    inputs.append({
        "title": project.get("title", ""),
        "content": content,
    })

compact = json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selected_projects_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[rewrite_inputs_json]]", compact)

return [{"json": {**data, "project_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
contents = json.loads(data["project_rewrite_response"]).get("contents")
indices = data.get("selected_project_indices")

if not isinstance(contents, list):
    raise ValueError("Project rewrite must contain contents.")
if not isinstance(indices, list):
    raise ValueError("selected_project_indices must be an array.")
if len(contents) != len(indices):
    raise ValueError("Project contents count does not match selected projects.")

source = data["master_cv"]["projects"]
tailored = []

for position, index in enumerate(indices):
    bullets = contents[position]
    if not isinstance(bullets, list) or any(
        not isinstance(bullet, str) for bullet in bullets
    ):
        raise ValueError("Each project content must be an array of strings.")

    rebuilt = dict(source[index])
    rebuilt.pop("description", None)
    rebuilt["content"] = bullets
    tailored.append(rebuilt)

return [{"json": {**data, "tailored_projects": tailored}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("work_experience_rewrite_prompt_template")
selected = data.get("selected_work_experiences")

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Work-experience rewrite prompt is missing.")
if not isinstance(selected, list):
    raise ValueError("selected_work_experiences must be an array.")

inputs = []
for experience in selected:
    content = experience.get("content")
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        raise ValueError("Each selected experience needs a content array.")
    inputs.append({
        "title": experience.get("title", ""),
        "organization": experience.get("organization", ""),
        "content": content,
    })

compact = json.dumps(inputs, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[selected_work_experiences_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[rewrite_inputs_json]]", compact)

return [{"json": {**data, "work_experience_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
template = data.get("summary_rewrite_prompt_template")

if not isinstance(template, str):
    raise ValueError("Summary prompt is missing.")

master_cv = data.get("master_cv")
if not isinstance(master_cv, dict):
    raise ValueError("master_cv must be an object.")

original_summary = master_cv.get("summary", [])
tailored_skills = data.get("tailored_skills", [])
tailored_projects = data.get("tailored_projects", [])
tailored_experiences = data.get("tailored_work_experience", [])

if not isinstance(original_summary, list):
    raise ValueError("master_cv.summary must be an array.")
if not isinstance(tailored_skills, list):
    raise ValueError("tailored_skills must be an array.")
if not isinstance(tailored_projects, list):
    raise ValueError("tailored_projects must be an array.")
if not isinstance(tailored_experiences, list):
    raise ValueError("tailored_work_experience must be an array.")

project_context = []
for project in tailored_projects:
    if not isinstance(project, dict):
        raise ValueError("Each tailored project must be an object.")
    project_context.append({
        key: value
        for key, value in project.items()
        if key != "description"
    })

experience_context = []
for experience in tailored_experiences:
    if not isinstance(experience, dict):
        raise ValueError("Each tailored work experience must be an object.")
    experience_context.append({
        key: value
        for key, value in experience.items()
        if key != "description"
    })

context = {
    "original_summary": original_summary,
    "tailored_skills": tailored_skills,
    "project_context": project_context,
    "experience_context": experience_context,
}

compact = json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
original_summary_json = json.dumps(
    original_summary,
    ensure_ascii=False,
    separators=(",", ":"),
)
tailored_skills_json = json.dumps(
    tailored_skills,
    ensure_ascii=False,
    separators=(",", ":"),
)
project_context_json = json.dumps(
    project_context,
    ensure_ascii=False,
    separators=(",", ":"),
)
experience_context_json = json.dumps(
    experience_context,
    ensure_ascii=False,
    separators=(",", ":"),
)

prompt = template
prompt = prompt.replace("[[job_description]]", data["job_description"])
prompt = prompt.replace("[[summary_context_json]]", compact)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[original_summary_json]]", original_summary_json)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[tailored_skills_json]]", tailored_skills_json)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[project_context_json]]", project_context_json)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[tailored_projects_json]]", project_context_json)
prompt = prompt.replace("[[experience_context_json]]", experience_context_json)
prompt = prompt.replace(
    "[[tailored_work_experience_json]]",
    experience_context_json,
)

return [{"json": {**data, "summary_rewrite_prompt": prompt}}]

import json

data = _items[0]["json"]
summary = json.loads(data["summary_rewrite_response"]).get("summary")

if not isinstance(summary, list) or any(
    not isinstance(line, str) for line in summary
):
    raise ValueError("Summary output must contain a summary array of strings.")

master_cv = data["master_cv"]

final_cv = {
    **master_cv,
    "summary": summary,
    "skills": data["tailored_skills"],
    "projects": data["tailored_projects"],
    "work_experience": data["tailored_work_experience"],
}

prompt_usage = {}
for key in (
    "project_selection",
    "project_rewrite",
    "work_experience_selection",
    "work_experience_rewrite",
    "skills_tailoring",
    "summary_rewrite",
):
    prompt_usage[key] = {
        "prompt_key": data.get(f"{key}_prompt_key"),
        "version": data.get(f"{key}_prompt_version"),
        "temperature": data.get(f"{key}_temperature"),
    }

return [{
    "json": {
        "cv_json": final_cv,
        "prompt_usage": prompt_usage,
        "selected_project_indices": data.get("selected_project_indices", []),
        "selected_work_experience_indices": data.get(
            "selected_work_experience_indices",
            [],
        ),
        "job_id": data.get("job_id"),
        "company_name": data.get("company_name"),
        "job_title": data.get("job_title"),
        "job_description": data.get("job_description"),
        "job_url": data.get("job_url"),
        "application_id": data.get("application_id"),
        "published_at": data.get("published_at"),
        "location": data.get("location"),
        "contract_type": data.get("contract_type"),
        "source_job": data.get("source_job"),
    }
}]
